reviews.text:
Bark Slope has been taking care of our dogs for many years, walking, monthly grooming and house/dog sitting when we go on vacation.
I can’t say enough about Bark Slope. I have three chihuahuas and they all run to the door especially when Jen comes in. They also love going to the groomer to see all their pals at the shop.
They truly care about the dogs and are very flexible and accommodating.
I highly highly recommend Bark Slope.
I visit this store often for Ollie’s treats. The staff are always friendly.  Nice assortment of treats, toys, clothing and pet food!

We took our dog Francine here many times over the years for self-serve baths and for nail trims. Staff is always friendly and professional, and they know who Fran is every time she walks through the door. Highly recommend Bark Slope for all your pet grooming needs!

I love how scruffy our dog is but he always need a trim before summer. We have gotten some bad haircuts in the past so I’m always nervous but Jamie made him look like a puppy again!!! I am beyond happy with the cut and Milhouse seems thrilled with it as well. Will 1000% be coming back to work with Jamie again. THANK YOU!!
They were super kind to my dog🙂 …

I'm really fond of this place; we've been visiting for two years now, and Australia seems like such a friendly part of the neighborhood. The staff is always warm and welcoming, and my dog truly adores them. We usually go there for baths for our dog, and it includes a complimentary handkerchief as a little gift. I wholeheartedly recommend this spot for delicious dog treats and baths. It's truly a wonderful place for pet owners.
We're a walking client, and we love Jenn and the team. They have been flexible with us during emergency situations and they are so good with our anxious pup. Highly recommend.

Bark Slope gained a loyal customer today! Our little rescue mutt Gus is super anxious and has been nippy with past groomers. We were looking for somewhere with extra experience with anxious dogs. We were recommended Lisa and she was AMAZING with Gus. I’ve never seen him leave a groomer this happy!!!

I brought my dog here recently and I couldn’t have had a better experience! Making an appointment was easy, the groomer was super friendly and my dog was relaxed for the whole service. I also picked up some fun products! I will definitely be back! 😊
Bark Slope does amazing grooming my mini goldendoodle. Every groomer we have used is awesome and patient and everyone who works there is great.

I decided to bring my dog here after being disappointed with other grooming options in the area. When you arrive, they make you sign a waiver that essentially removes all accountability on their end for anything that might happen to your pet while in their care. I was uncomfortable with that, but based on the amount of good reviews and seeing other owners using them, I went ahead.

When I returned to pick up my dog, the grooming itself was done nicely. However, another owner was holding her dog clearly distressed and a groomer was apologizing, telling her that although they were sorry, she had signed the waiver and they recommended she immediately take her dog to the vet for treatment. They offered not to charge her for the grooming, but the responsibility and additional cost of going to the vet fell entirely on the owner.

That moment made it clear to me that while they might did a decent job grooming, they take no real responsibility if something goes wrong. Watching another pet owner go through that after trusting them with her dog made me feel that this waiver is not just a formality it’s their way of avoiding accountability. Because of that, even though the grooming turned out fine for me, I don’t feel comfortable returning. A place that handles living animals should stand behind their work and take responsibility, not make owners sign their pet’s safety away.

I’m a retail, self service and self service bath customer at bark slope.

My 3 stars are for the retail and self service experience, all of the staff is great and the self service is always in good condition.

Where they fall incredibly short is in their grooming services. Unless you have a doodle or are doing a full shave, I would not recommend for more technical cuts. I’ve taken my Airedale in for grooming a total of 3 times with each time getting progressively worse. First time was more or less fine. The shorter areas were a bit patchy but over all fine. The second time they gave him a teddy bear haircut on his face, buzzed off his skirt so he was just one length all around and a Pom Pom tail??? The third time they completely shaved off his beard and still cut his skirt that I had been so patiently growing out from the last haircut. I asked if they shaved off his beard accidentally or if it was due to him moving a lot or being fussy because they were near his face and they assured me he was very well behaved thought out.

Overall my dog is unrecognizable and even more importantly, does not look like his breed.
